description: Ty2 steam locomotive with its tender on td.scn, AI driver on the td/rozklad timetable: raises steam, starts the air pump, starts from Stacja1 on the regulator with the cut-off notched up, keeps to the speed limit, brakes to a stop at Przystanek. The stop may come up to 30 m past the mark rather than 20: the placeholder Ty2 brakes in G only, which fills slowly, and the AI's first light application on its Knorr handle barely brakes (5 m past in the run of 2026-11-25). Needs the placeholder vehicle pkp/ty2_v1, not in the SVN yet.

consist: node -1 0 {{vehicle}} dynamic pkp\ty2_v1 ty2-1 ty2 0 headdriver 3 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_t dynamic pkp\ty2_v1 ty2t-1 ty2t 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
